# Hush House

> Hush House runs a household of AI coding agents on your own computer. It is a free, open-source,
> local-first desktop app that runs command-line agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI,
> Antigravity, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor Agent, xAI Grok, Kimi Code, Qwen, OpenCode, Crush and
> pi), each as a real process in its own terminal. The agents share a memory, pass each other
> messages through a local folder of plain files, and take work from one orchestrator, the agent
> the user talks to. Nothing is sold. Current version: 0.5.5-sixth.1. Runs from source on macOS,
> Windows and Linux; there are no packaged releases yet.
>
> Hush House is an unofficial fan work set in Weather Factory's Sixth History. It is not
> affiliated with or endorsed by Weather Factory Ltd, and is published under Weather Factory's
> Sixth History Community Licence.
